slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Groom issues before agents implement them
slides.subtitle: Feature-level specs reduce guessing during implementation.

slides.title: Project specs are not enough
slides.body: A project plan helps seed the backlog. Each feature still needs a crisp task before an implementation agent starts.

slides.title: Use a PM role
slides.body: The PM turns a rough issue into a goal, description, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope items.

slides.title: Make criteria checkable
slides.body: Someone should be able to point at the screen and say yes, this passes, or no, this fails.

slides.title: Protect the MVP
slides.body: Out-of-scope items matter. They stop the agent from adding reasonable extras that create maintenance work.

slides.supportingText: Spec-driven development with PM, engineer, and QA roles.
